description:
Fetch one judgment by id.

    section='summary' (default) returns metadata + the headnote (plain-language summary, the
    laws/provisions referred, and keyword tags) — read this first to judge relevance cheaply.
    section='full' additionally returns the judgment text; a long judgment arrives in its first part and says so.
    Long judgment: section='outline' gives a map (the judge's paragraph numbers, each separate opinion, the order),
    then paras='41-55' reads exactly those paragraphs (paras='2:3-5' = opinion 2, paragraphs 3-5, where separate
    opinions each restart their numbers), find='words' returns the paragraphs of this judgment that
    match, and start=N continues from a character position. These return the court's own words, never a summary.

case_id.description: Numeric judgment id (from a search/lookup/graph result)
case_id.title: Case Id

find.description: Words to look for inside this one judgment: returns the matching paragraphs, with their numbers
find.title: Find

paras.description: The judge's own paragraph numbers to read, e.g. '41-55' or '7'; '2:3-5' = opinion 2, paragraphs 3-5 ('notes' = the footnotes)
paras.title: Paras

section.description: 'summary' = metadata + headnote (cheap); 'outline' = a map of a long judgment; 'full' = + judgment text
section.title: Section

start.description: Read on from this character position (when a reply says More follows)
start.title: Start

name: caselaw_get_case
